about.title: About
about.p1: PreBell publishes a short premarket brief every US trading day before the open (index futures, the biggest premarket movers and why they moved, and what to watch) and an after-close recap after the bell (index closes, notable movers and why, and after-hours earnings to watch).
about.p2: Every post is generated automatically from public market data and news. Numbers are checked against the source data before publishing, and each post lists its sources. Times are US Eastern.
about.p3: English is published first; the Chinese version follows.

mcp.title: For AI agents
mcp.description: Connect your own AI agent to PreBell's read-only MCP server: the earnings calendar, earnings checks with their sources, and the latest brief.
mcp.intro: PreBell runs a read-only MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. Your own AI agent can use it to read the earnings calendar, the earnings checks (each figure with the sentence it came from, plus the SEC filing link) and the latest brief or recap. There is no sign-in: everything it serves is already public on this site.
mcp.otherClients: In another client, add it as a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) with the address above.

tools.earnings_calendar: Who reports earnings on which days and whether each date is confirmed, with the day's economic events (Fed decisions, jobs report, CPI).
tools.earnings_report: The newest earnings check PreBell has published for one company: the key figures, each with the press-release sentence it came from, and links to the check, the SEC filing and the press release. Without a check, it says whether the company has reported, or its next date on the calendar.
tools.latest_brief: The newest premarket brief or after-close recap: index futures or closes, the biggest movers with the published reason, and, in the premarket brief, the day's events to watch.

mcp.toolsLang: Titles and summaries come in Chinese when the Chinese version is published, otherwise in English; quoted filing text, mover reasons and the guidance and highlight notes stay in English.
ask: What did PreBell's latest earnings check on Apple show?
What did this morning's brief say?
limits: The brief is a snapshot written at set times, not a live feed: the premarket brief comes out from 8:00 AM Eastern on trading days and is usually rebuilt after 8:35 with fresh prices and any 8:30 economic releases, and the after-close recap from 4:45 PM Eastern (1:45 PM on early-close days). Before today's brief is out, your agent gets the most recent one, with a note saying when the next is due.
There are no live quotes: every price comes from a published brief or earnings check and carries its own time.

p: This policy applies to prebell.site and any other PreBell domain. By using the site you confirm that you have read it.
PreBell has no accounts and no comments. This is everything we collect.
ul: Weekly digest email. If you subscribe, we collect your email address. Buttondown, our newsletter provider, handles it and sends you a confirmation email first. You can unsubscribe from any email we send, or in Buttondown's preferences portal.
Technical data. The site runs on Cloudflare. Cloudflare's edge logs may record your IP address, browser and request metadata, for security and to operate the service.

Analytics. The site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits. It sets no cookies and does not track you across sites; it collects only aggregate visit data, such as the pages viewed, the referring site, the country and the browser type.
Cookies and storage. The site sets no cookies of its own. It uses your browser's storage only for display preferences, if at all.

p: We use this information to run and improve the site, send the digest you asked for, respond to your messages, prevent abuse and meet legal obligations.
Some pages carry affiliate links to brokers and exchanges. If you sign up through one, PreBell may earn a reward at no extra cost to you. These links are marked as sponsored.
Commissions do not influence what the site reports, which is generated from public data. Third-party sites have their own privacy policies, and we do not control them.
We do not sell personal data. Two providers process data on our behalf: Cloudflare (hosting, storage and analytics) and Buttondown (the newsletter). We disclose information when the law requires it.
We keep subscriber emails until you unsubscribe. Operational logs are kept only for the short periods our providers keep them.
You can ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, and you can withdraw your consent at any time by unsubscribing. To make a request, write to privacy@prebell.site.
PreBell is not directed at children under 16.
When this page changes, we update it and change the date at the top.

PreBell's content is generated automatically from public data (market briefs) and SEC filings (earnings checks) and is published for education and information only. It is not investment, financial, tax or legal advice, and not a recommendation to buy or sell any asset. Assess risks against your own situation before investing and consult a professional adviser where needed.

Posts are generated by software from public data: market quotes, SEC filings and news sources. They are checked against those sources before publishing, but errors can still occur. Data can be delayed or wrong, and the site may be unavailable. Figures are not guaranteed.
Each post lists its sources. Sites we link to are not ours.
The links under “Affiliate partners” are affiliate links: PreBell may earn a referral fee if you sign up through them.
You may read the site and share links to it. Do not scrape it at a rate that harms the service, and do not republish posts wholesale without credit.
The site's text and design belong to PreBell. Company names and logos belong to their owners and are used only to identify them.
To the extent the law allows, PreBell is not liable for losses arising from your use of the site or your reliance on its content.
These terms are governed by the laws of Ontario, Canada.

earnings.calendarDescription: US earnings dates for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100, with confirmed dates, reported results and links to the SEC filings.
earnings.legend: Confirmed: the company announced the date. Unconfirmed: the date comes from an aggregator and may change. Reported: the results are filed with the SEC. The largest companies get an earnings check; every other company's page links to its SEC filing.
earnings.tickerDescription: {ticker} earnings dates and PreBell earnings checks, with links to the SEC filings.
earnings.chartsNote: Charts show GAAP figures from SEC filings; the last bar marked 8-K is this release. A gap means the company did not report that quarter separately.
earnings.checkedFiling: ✓ Every figure traced to the filing
earnings.countCompanies: {count, plural, =0 {No companies} one {# company} other {# companies}}
earnings.countEvents: {count, plural, one {# economy event} other {# economy events}}

events.legend: Economy & Fed: official dates from the BLS, the Federal Reserve, US law (elections) and the NYSE (closures), linked to their source and, once out, to the release.
